decisions.reason: The candidate already records the requirement to provide a removal rationale. The newly specified Google Doc deletion, suggesting-mode, and commenting procedure belongs to the separate editing-workflow Requirement and does not alter the curation criteria or goal.
The question-removal editing workflow does not change the mandatory or optional layers required in retained-question answers.
The procedure for recording proposed question removals does not change how the international perspective must be integrated.
The removal workflow does not change the AI chapter's mandatory status, covered material, or length guidance.
The removal workflow does not modify the subject or length guidance of the candidate-questions chapter.
The removal workflow does not modify the content focus or length policy of the first-time-leader chapter.
The removal workflow does not change the pre-interview checklist's deliverable type, audience focus, content guidance, or length guidance.
The removal workflow does not modify the remote and hybrid leadership chapter's subject or length guidance.
The manuscript question-removal procedure does not change the required companion-resource types or their delivery format.
The question-removal editing procedure does not change the production-readiness standard for companion templates.
The question-removal editing procedure does not change the video-script deliverable or the editorial team's recording responsibility.
Removing questions may create capacity under the ceiling, but the specified removal-recording workflow does not change the 110,000-word maximum or the recorded approximate existing length.
